description: Renames a file and/or updates its description and starred flag — metadata only, the content is untouched (that is upload_file with file_id). Only the provided fields change; at least one is required. Works on folders too (folders are files). Returns id, name, description, starred and the new modifiedTime. Moving lives in move_file, trashing in trash_file.

description.description: New description (shown in the Drive details pane; searchable via full text).

file_id.description: The file id — the long id from the Drive URL (drive.google.com/file/d/<fileId> or docs.google.com/.../d/<fileId>/edit) or from search_files/get_file output. Folders and shared-drive items are files too.

name.description: New file name (the extension is part of the name — keep it unless you mean to change it).

name: update_file_metadata
title: Rename / update file metadata
